description: This file defines the 'actionModifyRecord' class, which extends 'actionCreateRecord'. It handles modifying existing records within the SuiteCRM platform, including functions for loading JavaScript, rendering an edit display form with dynamic fields, and executing the modification action on linked related records.

classes.name: actionModifyRecord
classes.description: A class that extends 'actionCreateRecord' to modify existing records, including loading scripts and display forms, and performing the record update logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class, optionally with an ID.

methods.description: Loads JavaScript, delegating to the parent class's implementation.

methods.name: edit_display
methods.description: Generates HTML and JavaScript to display a form for editing record-related data, including module relationship selectors and dynamic field management.

methods.name: run_action
methods.description: Executes the modify action on the given bean, updating related records if necessary.
